suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy that went out clean on a Friday and didn't ruin my weekend.
I'm thankful for the first teh tarik of the day actually being hot, not the lukewarm one from the flask.
I'm grateful for catching a null pointer in code review before it became someone else's 3am problem.
I'm thankful for the stillness right before Fajr, before the group chats start blowing up.
I'm grateful for a landlord who fixed the leaking pipe the same day I texted him.
I'm thankful for my dad still insisting on driving me to the airport even though I keep telling him not to bother.
I'm grateful for a sprint retro where nobody got defensive and the feedback actually landed.
I'm thankful for the rezeki of a job that pays on time while a few friends are still chasing their salaries.
I'm grateful for finding the one stray semicolon that broke the entire build.
I'm thankful for roti canai still being warm when I show up ten minutes late.
I'm grateful for a long drive back to Kuala Lumpur with good traffic and better music.
I'm thankful for a colleague who covers for me without making it a whole negotiation.
I'm grateful for the breeze right after the rain stops, before the humidity creeps back in.
I'm thankful for a terawih that actually clears my head instead of just ticking a box.
I'm grateful for a staging environment that caught the bug I would've sworn was impossible.
